items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I become interested in her... I didn't want her put out of the show so I was going to quit if they put her out.

ctx.x: After this initial experience with her when was it that you realized that she was someone you were very interested in?
At this point, at this point I become interested in her when

they put her out of the show, that's when I became interested and I didn't want her put out of the show so I was going to quit if they put her out. I'm going to quit. Understand? So they don't put her out of the show. She's an Equity member now, too. Don't forget that. Listen, they couldn't fire her whether they wanted to fire her -- they had to pay her fare back to London and they had to pay her just like they pay all the rest of the actors that they paid and the only ones that could get paid was the ones that…
